title: Cottage lifted onto temporary crib supports during unpermitted repairs
jurisdiction: Saskatchewan; local authority redacted in the published decision

facts.text: The orders state that work began without a building permit, the dwelling was raised and temporarily placed on piers, decks were demolished, and floor-assembly repairs were underway.
The remedy order identifies ungraded crib blocking on grade with a plywood base, damaged floor joists without mid-span support, and building-envelope damage.
The decision notes that the authority lacked design drawings and that a complete building-permit application with design drawings was needed for review.
